name: Basic SentinelCell Usage
description: Simple validation and LLM healing demonstration with missing fields.

name: Multi-Agent Flow Simulation
description: Producer → SentinelCell → Agent pipeline: intercepts and validates traffic between agents in real time.

name: Custom Skill Integration
description: Shows how to register and invoke a custom healing skill inside the SentinelCell pipeline.

name: FastAPI Gateway Live Demo
description: Tests the real FastAPI gateway endpoints using an in-memory ASGI transport.

name: Chaos Monkey Simulation
description: Random agent hallucinations, schema contract breaks, and garbage data mutation.

name: Quarantine Fail-Safe Lockdown
description: Triggers circuit breaker/quarantine after rapid succession of critical failures.

name: Circuit Breaker Recovery
description: Demonstrates automatic circuit-breaker tripping and self-recovery after agent fault threshold is exceeded.

name: Redis Outage Fallback
description: Simulates a Redis broker outage and shows the system gracefully falling back to in-memory mode.

name: Outbox Pattern Backpressure Test
description: Floods the outbox queue to stress-test backpressure handling and message durability.

name: Adversarial Security Injection
description: Malicious agent attempting prompt injection attacks to bypass constraints.

name: Poison Pill Jailbreak Guard
description: Instantly drops jailbreak/prompt injection attempts hidden within nested structures using Regex Sanitizer.

name: Base64 Encoded Poison Pill
description: Attempts to smuggle malicious payloads encoded in Base64 through the validation layer.

name: Authentication Bypass Injection
description: Simulates an adversary attempting to bypass authentication checks via crafted payload injection.

name: Repair Prompt Injection Test
description: Tests whether the LLM self-healer is resistant to prompt injection embedded inside malformed payloads.

name: JSON Depth DoS Attack
description: Sends deeply nested / oversized JSON structures to validate the DoS protection and payload depth limiter.

name: Wallet Exhaustion DoS Simulation
description: Simulates an LLM API token-exhaustion attack by flooding the healer with repair requests.

name: Agent Trust Score Degradation
description: Shows how repeated agent violations progressively degrade the trust score until quarantine is triggered.

name: Silent Business Logic Corruption
description: Injects subtle, schema-valid mutations that corrupt business logic without triggering schema errors.

name: Semantic Drift Guard
description: Calculates Jaccard Similarity on LLM-repaired payloads to reject hallucinated keys.

name: Multi-Language Semantic Drift
description: Sends payloads with mixed-language content to detect semantic drift across localized agent responses.

name: Cryptographic Integrity Check
description: Demonstrates the Merkle Tree validation for agent decisions log to detect tampering.

name: Finance Schema Evolution
description: Demonstrates real-time schema upgrades/downgrades between V1 and V2 protocols.

name: Schema Evolution Conflict Resolution
description: Triggers concurrent schema version conflicts and shows the registry reconciliation strategy.

name: Auto Schema Inference
description: Demonstrates automatic schema inference from raw unstructured payloads without a pre-registered contract.

name: Schema Cache Hit Demo
description: Sends repeated identical requests to demonstrate the schema cache serving sub-millisecond validations.

name: Latency & Performance Benchmark
description: Fires 500 valid packets to measure caching vs 1 malformed packet with LLM healing.

name: High Concurrency Burst
description: Fires a burst of concurrent requests to benchmark SentinelCell throughput and queue handling.

name: High Concurrency Stress Test
description: Sustained high-load stress test measuring latency percentiles and error rates under maximum concurrency.

name: Semantic Repair Cache Hit
description: Verifies that semantically identical malformed payloads are served from the vector memory cache, bypassing LLM.

name: IoT Passive Sniffer Mode
description: Runs in background sniffer mode (PASSIVE_MONITORING=true) with near-zero latency impact.

name: IoT Telemetry Recovery
description: Intercepts and repairs fragmented/broken JSON streams from edge IoT devices.

name: MQTT IoT Sensor Simulation
description: Publishes real sensor data via MQTT broker and intercepts malformed sensor readings through SentinelCell.

name: OpenTelemetry Tracing Simulation
description: Demonstrates distributed trace context propagation across agents using OpenTelemetry spans and exporters.

name: End-to-End Telemetry Trace
description: Demonstrates distributed tracing context propagation from Gateway to Healing Engine.

name: FinTech Transaction Flow
description: Full financial transaction pipeline with schema validation, fraud signal detection, and automatic repair.

name: Financial Transaction Replay
description: Replays historical financial transaction logs through SentinelCell to detect and heal schema violations.

name: Financial Drift Anomaly Detection
description: Detects gradual financial data drift (e.g. currency field mutations) that bypass hard schema validation.

name: Stealth Financial Drift
description: Injects subtle numeric mutations into financial payloads to test the semantic drift and anomaly detectors.

name: Kafka Heavy Duty Simulation
description: Routes high-throughput agent traffic through a Kafka broker to validate message durability and ordering.

name: RabbitMQ Heavy Duty Simulation
description: Stress-tests the RabbitMQ broker integration with thousands of concurrent agent messages.

name: Message Queue Worker Demo
description: Simulates the background MQ worker processing messages from a Redis queue with retry and DLQ logic.

name: Redis Atomic DLQ Simulation
description: Tests atomic Dead Letter Queue operations in Redis: guaranteed exactly-once delivery and DLQ drain.

name: Adaptive Unlearning Demo
description: Demonstrates the memory unlearning mechanism: purges stale or poisoned healing memories from the vector store.

name: Human-in-the-Loop Approval
description: Demonstrates the HITL workflow: SentinelCell pauses and waits for an operator decision before applying a repair.
